hubstaff_bill_rate.description: Hubstaff bill_rate if present. Never send pay_rate / HH PH / net pay to QBO. Do not auto-copy tracker rate columns into QBO writes.

qbo_customer_id.description: QBO customer for the real client (legal entity). Not a customer-per-VA. Alexander 2026-08-27.

qbo_item_id.description: QBO Product/Service (type Service) for this VA. Alexander: each VA is a Service item; those items populate sales receipts.

qbo_service_name.description: Display name of the VA Service. Appears on the sales receipt.

qbo_revenue_account_id.description: Chart of Accounts revenue account on the VA Service. Matt/Alexander; do not invent.

qbo_service_rate.description: Optional standard client bill rate on the Service item, or line override. Not Hubstaff pay / HH PH / net pay. Do not auto-copy tracker rate columns.

qbo_line_id.description: Existing sales-receipt line for this VA Service, if already on the recurring receipt.

qbo_hours_field.description: Qty/hours on the sales-receipt line for the VA Service (Alexander 2026-08-27). Not a mystery custom field.

client_name.description: Tracker DBA: Client List column Client Name

legal_business_name.description: Tracker Legal Business Name (QBO customer legal name candidate)

va_name.description: Tracker VA Name (from-tracker.csv; one row per VA assignment). Maps to qbo_service_name.

va_number.description: Parsed from VA Name (VA# / VA #). Maps toward qbo_va_number once Matt confirms.

expected_hours.description: Tracker Expected Hours Worked. Sparsely filled on Client List.

actual_hours.description: Tracker Actual Hours Worked. On Client List this currently holds contracted weekly hours (20/40), not last-week Hubstaff actuals.

weekly_hours_col.description: Rolling weekly hours column header, e.g. HH061 (Aug 24-30). Source of truth for that week's billed hours once populated.

weekly_hours_value.description: Value in the current weekly hours column. Empty on ingest week of 2026-08-26.

tracker_sheet_row.description: Row number on Client List tab (for audit, not a billing key)

tracker_rate_columns_never_write.description: TRACKER-ONLY / NEVER AUTO-WRITE TO QBO: VA Hourly Rate to Client, VA Hourly Rate to HH PH, VAs Hourly Net Pay, Onboarding Fee. Client bill rate on the Service is Matt-entered if used. HH PH and net pay never go to QBO.
